title: SEASON ZERO FOUNDATION: WHAT YOU WEAR CHANGES HOW YOU PLAY
why: his progression plan of 11-01 (m0): one place every stat reads gear from, so worn pieces make the pillager stronger; with nothing worn it changes nothing
now: move speed, stamina, reload, spread, noise, how far you are seen, bandage time, time on the floor, reviving and searching all read what you wear, summed once per raid; nothing is worn yet so every raid plays exactly as before, the robots and the demo never read it
